authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 986 asmad gives regional ham we, Oriya ami/āme, Marathi āmhī and Gujarati ame. Selected hamu and ami first-person plural forms fit this family; the final u in hamu is retained as a regional extension. Source inclusive/exclusive labels are preserved without claiming the historical root encoded that distinction. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: ami.
